label: S.Res. 817
title: An executive resolution authorizing the en bloc consideration in Executive Session of certain nominations on the Executive Calendar.

items.snippet: Agencies in which the executive officers shall serve include the Departments of Defense, Energy, the Interior, State, and the Treasury.

items.item: United Nations, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD)
items.snippet: Additional nominees shall represent the United States to, among others, the United Nations, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), Brazil, Cambodia, Cyprus, and the Gambia.
Nominees are also appointed to the National Labor Relations Board, National Transportation Safety Board, Consumer Product Safety Commission, and District of Columbia (DC) courts.
